summary: Validated HttpOnly cookie auth migration (Phase 1 remediation) end-to-end: 10/10 backend pytest tests + full frontend E2E flow all green. Login via cookies works, /auth/me works via cookie AND via Authorization Bearer (backward compat), refresh rotates access_token, logout sends Max-Age=0, dashboard + notifications endpoints authenticate via cookie. No tokens leaked in body or in localStorage/sessionStorage. No console errors in DashboardLayout - orphan code removal confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: deps.py correctly prefers Authorization header over cookie when both present - good for explicit Bearer override during testing.
_cookie_kwargs() correctly forces secure=True when samesite=none (browser requirement). Documented switch for prod (COOKIE_SAMESITE=none) is clean.
auth.py /auth/login response body now exposes only user dict (no tokens) - matches XSS hardening goal.
Frontend api.js axios instance uses withCredentials:true and 401 interceptor only removes sessionStorage.user and redirects - no localStorage token references anywhere. Clean migration.
DashboardLayout.js no longer has the orphan duplicate block; handleLogout calls authAPI.logout() then clears sessionStorage and navigates - correct order.
Minor: server.py CORS allow_origins is a hard list with allow_credentials=True - correct (cannot be '*' with credentials). No issue.

Carryover from iteration_5: backend monolithic server.py concerns no longer apply since routers are split (auth.py confirmed). Earlier minor RBAC observations (products/invoices open to all roles, inventory tenant check) are out of scope of this cookie migration.
test_credentials: admin.tj/Admin@2026 (regular tenant, username login) and master@sconnecta.com.br/Master@2026 (is_master=true). Both worked.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; relied on existing seeded users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie auth migration is solid. Backend cookie flags observed in preview: HttpOnly=true, SameSite=Lax, Secure=true. In Cloudflare+Railway prod, user must set COOKIE_SAMESITE=none + COOKIE_SECURE=true (front and back on different origins) and ensure CORS_ORIGINS contains the exact frontend origin (Cloudflare Pages URL or sconnecta.com.br). Backend deps.py supports both cookie and Bearer header so existing pytest regression suite test_multitenant_saas.py continues to pass. Two cookie-clear edge cases worth a future regression: (a) calling /auth/logout when no cookies present (currently returns 200 - acceptable), (b) /auth/refresh with expired refresh token (returns 401 from decode_token - acceptable).
rca of the issue: No new bugs found. The previously broken state (cookies set but header-only reader on deps.py) was already fixed by the main agent before this iteration: deps.get_current_user now accepts Cookie(access_token) OR Authorization Bearer header; frontend api.js sends withCredentials:true; LoginPage stores only user (no tokens) in sessionStorage; DashboardLayout orphan duplicate block removed. Full E2E (login -> dashboard -> Produtos -> Estoque -> logout -> redirect guard) executes without 401s or console errors.
